'''Rik Torrence''' was a skilled and cavalier [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[T-47 sandspeeder/Legends|sandspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who was assigned as the leader of [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]] at [[Arda Base]] around five years after his recruitment after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shut down a transport corporation in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], [[Torrence Run]] near the base was named after him, although he clashed with [[Var Narek]]. He survived the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]].<ref name="OAA1" />
